headlines.title: PDD Holdings shares jump as quarterly earnings top forecasts
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- PDD Holdings shares surged about 8% in premarket trading Thursday after the company reported adjusted earnings and operating profit that beat analyst estimates. Revenue, however, fell short of forecasts, driven by a shortfall in transaction services.

headlines.title: PDD Holdings Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
headlines.summary: DUBLIN and SHANGHAI, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PDD Holdings Inc. (“PDD Holdings” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PDD), today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Total revenues in the quarter were RMB108.3 billion (US$116.2 billion), compared with RMB108.3 billion in the same quarter of 2025.Operating profit in the quarter was RMB31.2 billion (US$4.6 billion).

description: PDD Holdings Inc., a multinational commerce group that owns and operates a portfolio of businesses. The company operates Pinduoduo platform, which provides various product categories and interactive shopping experiences; and Temu, an online platform, which enables merchants to streamline their manufacturing and commercial operations. The company was formerly known as Pinduoduo Inc. and changed its name to PDD Holdings Inc. in February 2023. PDD Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
